name: Inflammatory Bowel Disease
description: Chronic relapsing inflammatory disorders of the gastrointestinal tract encompassing Crohn's Disease (CD — transmural inflammation, any GI segment, skip lesions, granulomas) and Ulcerative Colitis (UC — mucosal inflammation limited to colon, continuous from rectum). Driven by dysregulated immune response to gut microbiota in genetically susceptible individuals with impaired epithelial barrier.
primary_tissue: GI tract (CD: mouth-to-anus, transmural; UC: colon only, mucosal)
